title: Kayo Premium: $1 First Month for New Customers, Ongoing $45.99/Month @ Kayo
body:
Deal: Kayo Premium: $1 First Month for New Customers, Ongoing $45.99/Month @ Kayo

[mitcheo] Kayo/hubbl is a glitchy, overpriced sports streaming service in a scammy ecosystem that is hard to cancel
[Arkhxm] Is there any suitable alternative, especially for Formula 1?
[giventofly] I am using IPTV with the UHF app and UHF Server to record to my NAS (for shows I want to watch later). Works perfectly.
Has Sky Sports F1.
[Maloo] Can you elobrate a bit for us non tech heads, please.
[niknikniknik] @Maloo: It's an illegal streaming service through an IPTV provider. UHF is one of the more polished IPTV player apps, through which you link your IPTV subscription streaming credentials to play the content. They normally come with hundreds if not thousands of international channels which would cover most sports and on demand content.
[giventofly] @Maloo: Happy to.
Mods, delete if against rules.
I am using KenoaTV. It works well and the streams are of good 1080p quality, very watchable.
I signed up to a trial to test it out for 24-hours, and then added the stream URL they provide to the UHF app on my Apple TV. I liked the app so much that I just bought a licence for it. You can use it for free however.
KenoaTV gives you heaps of streams for stations around the world. These sports channels show sports from F1 to AFL, to EPL and so on. You just have to browse to find the channel you want. I added channels I want to watch regularly to my favourites. Find the one you want, and watch.
Because the sports I watch are often early morning, I set up UHF server for recordings. The recordings go to my NAS and I can watch the replay locally. Works perfectly.
Hope that helps.
[giventofly] @HereYeeHereYee: I am sure it would - Fox Sports can be flaky, so I have to watch AFL via international channels.
I don't watch NRL so couldn't tell you which international channels have it
[frondono] probably the loop addon for kodi or try sportsurge dot net (.net).
[jv] that is hard to cancel
How is it hard to cancel ???
'Cancel' is one of the options on the account managment screen.
[sween64] Need a verified mobile number for a new account.
You can get an extra month without paying if you add a payment method that will decline payments (insufficient funds works well).
[cheap4321] shh… I've gotten 6 months for $3 this year and have another $1 offer - the gift that keeps on giving.
[JAF] It’s $46/mth now?! Wasn’t this their cheaper Foxtel alternative if you only wanted sports? You might as well just get Foxtel at these prices
[jv] I don't think Foxtel allows you to timeshift live games.
[PinzVidz] Kayo (DAZN) can go suck some big hairy you-know-whats. Constant QR login requests, dodgy UI changes, Netflix/Disney+ type crackdown on legitimate 2 stream usage in different households. Kents.
[50cent] Is the 2 stream designed only for samehouse hold?
[nroko86] Last time I tried to cancel I kept encountering a glitch. I had to go through chat support, they then provided link to cancel.
[giventofly] Lol, I literally just cancelled my subscription about 3 minutes ago. I am so done with it.
I am now getting an ad for Kayo within the app when I click onto a livestream, and I was getting them during the F1. All for the price of $45 a month.
IPTV here I come.

[Hank Scorpion] If you want to keep Kayo all year around there's also football clubs that do digital memberships with Kayo, you can get Kayo Premium for $335 and less for standard, I split the cost so ~$167 a year.
[Hank Scorpion] Sydney Roosters, only problem is you become a Sydney Roosters club member.
https://www.roosters.com.au/membership/packages/from-your-ho…
[Odwin] Neat, any caveats to this or does the cheapest legit kayo sub really involve becoming a club member?
[Hank Scorpion] @Odwin: As I said, the one big caveat, you become a Sydney roosters member, just don't tell anyone what you did and the savings may just make it tolerable. There's some reddit threads which track the digital kayo membership costs for most of the AFL/NRL clubs too, I've had AFL club memberships in the past as well.
They send you a voucher for the subscription, the Roosters one got processed through ticketmaster, you just input the voucher code when you signup/renew. Mine took a day to arrive, so I'm thinking someone manually processes these?
[Whatisthatvelvet] Done that for a few years but didn't renew it a couple months back.
I thought Kayo was cracking down on the account sharing?
[hrcdan] Switched to iptv months ago and havn’t looked back, search previous kayo deals for instructions and tips, fiddly to start with but easy once set up
[Kammi] Fwiw, I signed up to $45.99/m, cancelled that then they offered $35.99, now cancelled that & they offered $25.99 for next 6m
[WorkingLowJam] Thanks, I just went to cancel after reading your comment and got the $25.99 for next 6m offer. Easy.
